articles.summary: NEW YORK, Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Valley National Bancorp ( NASDAQ:VLY ), the holding company for Valley National Bank, announced that it will release its third quarter 2026 earnings before the market opens on Thursday, October 22, 2026. Valley’s CEO, Ira Robbins will host a conference call on Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 8:30 AM (ET) to discuss Valley’s third quarter 2026 earnings. Interested parties should pre-register using this link: https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BIc78e7eea64034897b9189c4e4fb690d9 to receive the dial-in number and a personal PIN, which are required to access the conference call. The teleconference will also be webcast live: https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/8hirkq3z and archived on Valley’s website through Monday, November 23, 2026.
